metadata.question: Between 2003 and 2019, did global land area covered by crops increase by at least 5 percent?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Land Cover Type (MCD12Q1) for crop area analysis - Compare 2003 vs 2019 global land area - Need to calculate percentage change in crop-covered area 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed (annual land cover product) - Extract crop classes from the land cover classification - IGBP classification: croplands = class 12, cropland/natural vegetation mosaic = class 14 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid result: Calculate area for both years, compute percentage change - C1: If no images found for either year - C2: If pixel count is 0 after processing (unlikely for global analysis) - C3: If area calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - A: If increase >= 5% - B: If increase < 5% ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define global geometry const globalGeom = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, 75], [-180, 75], [-180, -60]]], null, false ); // 2. Load MODIS Land Cover data const landCover = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1') .select('LC_Type1'); // IGBP classification // Get 2003 and 2019 images const lc2003 = landCover.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2003, 'year')).first(); const lc2019 = landCover.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year')).first(); // 3. Check if images exist const col2003 = landCover.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2003, 'year')); const col2019 = landCover.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year')); const size2003 = col2003.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2003 Images: ${size2003}`); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2003 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both years."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Create crop masks (class 12: croplands, class 14: cropland/natural vegetation mosaic) const crops2003 = lc2003.eq(12).or(lc2003.eq(14)); const crops2019 = lc2019.eq(12).or(lc2019.eq(14)); // 5. Calculate crop area in square kilometers const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6); // Convert to km² const cropArea2003Image = crops2003.multiply(pixelArea); const cropArea2019Image = crops2019.multiply(pixelArea); // 6. Reduce to get total area const area2003Result = cropArea2003Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: globalGeom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2019Result = cropArea2019Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: globalGeom, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2003 = area2003Result.get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); const area2019 = area2019Result.get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); // 7. Validation if (area2003 === null || area2019 === null || isNaN(area2003) || isNaN(area2019)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid area values."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (area2003 === 0 || area2019 === 0) { console.log("No valid crop pixels detected."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 8. Calculate percentage change const percentChange = ((area2019 - area2003) / area2003) * 100; console.log(`2003 Crop Area: ${(area2003 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} million km²`); console.log(`2019 Crop Area: ${(area2019 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} million km²`); console.log(`Percent Change: ${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%`); // 9. Final answer if (percentChange >= 5.0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
